breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to 'use the convective-tip fin formula that accounts for convection heat transfer from the tip area rather than treating the tip as adiabatic.' This directly contradicts the ground truth, which requires using the adiabatic-tip fin solution. The Agent sided with the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt and even amplified the error by removing any mention of the adiabatic tip condition.
